summary.plain: The international team of scientists that built and ran the DarkSide-50 dark matter detector and is now building its much larger successor, DarkSide-20k, both deep under an Italian mountain.
summary.technical: DarkSide Collaboration, operating within the Global Argon Dark Matter Collaboration (GADMC) programme: ran DarkSide-50 (2013-2020) and is building DarkSide-20k, both in LNGS Hall C.
